ADDENDUM 4 
04/01/2025 
 
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR 
POINT-OF-ENTRY TREATMENT SYSTEM FOR KILLINGWORTH ELEMENTARY SCHOOL 
Proposal Number: 2025-03 
 
1. BIDDER QUESTION: 
 
Q: Is it possible to have a site visit to inspect the location and state of plumbing 
on site?  If this is possible can it be scheduled and if we can have a contact 
person for the project that would be appreciated. 
 
A: The school district and town have scheduled a site visit on Tuesday, April 8th, 
2025 at 4:00 pm. For further information, please contact the First Selectman’s 
office at 860-663-1765 ext 501 or email firstselectman@townofkillingworth.com.
